up-sqlite3: SQLite 3.54.1 command line shell (sqlite3) in UP-Term:bin

Contents: SQLite 3.54.1 command line shell (sqlite3) in UP-Term:bin
Licence: Public domain; see LICENSES.txt.

Needs up-term.lha installed first (version 1.0 or newer). In an UP-Term window, in vsh:
  sqlite3

Install: run Install (Installer) or, with upkg, install up-sqlite3. Uninstall takes the package out
again; the UP-Term Uninstall runs it first.
